title: Website wan IATF
summary: Site n addinat i International Accessibility Task Force
problem: IATF ila derhan n ehan n addinat wa eɣnan s almaɣna n dumu , isalan n addabara tan d titbaqqa n imuzaran s edag wa olaɣan
why: Edag eqal ehan wa maqaran ən IATF. Eqal atiwagan sund ehan ogaran təmidrit ye adigriwnat taɣare, afanaz əd ugiš dǎɣ edag ahusken.
scopeIn: Iɣanni n isuj win ijjit n almaɣna n dumu wan IATF
Rejistir n addinat n haratan ijjan IATF, wi axdamnen d wi iknanen alxidmat s talɣa, maintainer, repository d demo
Tabarat d dumu n asidu n addaror
Iɣanni tan n alxakum d tijittawt
Eɣanni n tangilist id edey iknan s afissar
Amsədu iknan fal Cloudflare Workers Static Assets
scopeOut: Ihandagan win addinat wi war n ila alxakum, account tan meɣ login flows
Ahanay ən əmik wan santo ən əšiɣil, wa izzaɣan dǎɣ edag ən huk ən əšəɣil kul
Majrad daɣ azzaman wan tiditt izzaɣ daɣ Discord
Issue tracking fal haratan n awadim izzaɣan daɣ repository n haratan fuk daɣ GitHub

title: IATF selfie

problem: Akayad ezzaran n asuj ijjan fal tudabat n ijjuch daɣ IATF
why: Repository eqqal a ijrawan i addinat chund akatab n alxidmat kuddeɣ as efes net ikfa turhajat
scopeIn: Almital wa ezzaran n asuj ijjan fal tudabat n ijjuch ijjan chund akayad n addinat
scopeOut: Ašiɣil n efes meɣ alxidmat tan samalan
